description: Prior approval for the erection of an additional floor above the existing first floor
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Site Location Plan, Block Plan, 21-MB-04, 21-MB-05, 21-MB-06, Vision Impact for Neigbour Plan, Sunlight Impact for Neighbour Plan . Received 19 March 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the additional storeys hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof pitch of the principal part of the dwellinghouse following the development shall be the same as the roof pitch of that of the existing dwellinghouse.

Condition : 6 - Following the development, the dwellinghouse must be used as a dwellinghouse within the meaning of Class C3 of the Schedule to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the primary use as a dwellinghouse.

Condition : 7 - Within 28 calendar days of completion of the development hereby approved, the developer shall notify the Local Planning Authority in writing of the completion of the development.
The notification shall be in writing and shall include the name of the developer; the address of the dwellinghouse; and the date of completion.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the commencement of the development, the developer must submit in writing a report for the management of the construction of the development, which sets out the proposed development hours of operation and how any adverse impact of noise, dust, vibration and traffic on adjoining owners or occupiers will be mitigated.
